data.name: Bahiyy
data.gender_notes: Bahiyy is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ba-ha-ya, meaning 'to shine, to illuminate'. In Islamic context, Bahiyy can symbolize a clear and radiant soul, enlightened by the light of knowledge and faith. This name is often given to girls who are expected to bring light and clarity to their families and communities. The name Bahiyy carries the meaning “Illuminated, Radiant, Clear” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bahiyy usually hope their child will grow to embody illuminated, radiant, clear and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Bahiyy belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Illuminated, Radiant, Clear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bahiyy total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
